notes.title: Dreamwalkers is going live
notes.notes:
Hi friends,

This is with great pleasure that I can announce that after many twists and turns, the Dreamwalkers is finally ready for release and will be available on Monday September 30.

When I launched the project in September 2018 with Yoshi, a screenwriter friend, the idea was to create our first video game in less than two years. A VN because we love stories and believe in their magical power.
Bastien soon joined us as art director, closely followed by a number of talented artists. The characters were born, and with them the scenery, sound, music and game code.

But creating a game takes time, a lot of time, and even more when it's the first time! So in 2020, after 2 years on the project, I had to go back to work and put the game on pause. Dreamwalkers went dormant.

In September 2023, however, the frustration became too great, and the desire to finish it, to release it, took over. So I got back to work, with Hugo our developer, adding chapters, testing branches, ordering new settings. What a pleasure to see our work finally come to life!

Creating The Dreamwalkers has been a great adventure for me and for us. I hope you enjoy accompanying Morgan, wandering through Dreams and discovering the world Yoshi has created.

Enjoy the game!
Matthieu
September 2024

notes.title: Enjoy the demo!
notes.notes:
Hey there !

Some two years ago, we embarked on a journey to create our first video game.
Because we wanted to tell the story of a world.
A world where dreams can be explored, where Nightmares haunt you. 

The demo we share with you is an alpha version of the game.
We tried to make it as polished as we could. There is still a lot of work to do until the release in October but we hope that you'll enjoy this foretaste ;)

Enjoy the demo and please share your thoughts on the community hub.

PS : The story you're about to enjoy is set in an alternate "reality" where Ros is called to the rescue.
In the released game in October, you'll play as Morgan.

notes.title: The Dreamwalkers's demo will be available for a short time!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that we'll take part to this year's Steam Game Festival, Summer Edition.

Starting Tuesday, June 9th, you'll be able to play the demo of [i]The Dreamwalkers[/i].
We can't wait to share with you the alpha version of our game!

You'll play Ros, as she's been summoned to Paris by Helo.
There, she'll find Morgan in a bad state..

Your choices will decide which one of the four paths you'll unlock.

The demo is set in an alternate reality of the upcoming game so don't worry for spoilers ;)

Enjoy the demo and please share your opinion!
